content.text:
Yes, new night wakings are really common around 18 to 24 months. Common causes are a developmental leap, separation worries, teething, or a nap and bedtime that have drifted.

Tonight, keep the 2am visit boring. Go in, say a short calm line like "it's sleep time, I'm here," and give a quick pat or a hand on their back. Keep the lights off and don't pick them up or start a snack, and leave while they're drowsy but still awake. That keeps the waking from turning into a new routine.

If they seem sick or in pain, or something just feels off, call Health811 at 811 any time. For an emergency, call 911.
